smokeTests.name: capability_review_engine_duration_review_card_duration
smokeTests.setup: Preserve card.duration in a seeded guardrail input and replay candidate scenario.
smokeTests.expect: Guardrail downgrades to review and keeps the card out of auto-integration.

smokeTests.name: capability_reject_engine_unsupported_timing_card_timing_0
smokeTests.setup: Run guardrail on a structured card that still contains card.timing.0.
smokeTests.expect: Guardrail rejects the card and surfaces the exact unsupported capability issue.
